Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. To keep momentum, we're trying to lock the scoping work for the Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) and confirm whether Redwood can accept the HelioHealth UK Addendum (we raised this during the sales PO). Specifically we need:

- A current subprocessor list and the regions where HelioHealth data may transit or be processed.
- Your proposed controls for logging/retention and whether audit logs can be exported for customer review.
- A draft UK Addendum (or confirmation you accept ours) and an approximate signature timeline.
- Any dependencies for on-prem or VPC options (we may need to isolate a pilot for UK customers).

We're attaching a basic data map to help prioritize (high-risk categories highlighted). Target: have draft UK Addendum + scoping notes by EOD Thursday so our legal team can review before next procurement cycle. Can you confirm owners and a realistic timeline?

Attachments: Helio_DataMap_Q1.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Privacy Operations | HelioHealth

- Subprocessor list: we have a current export that we can share; will include region-by-region processing locations.
- Audit logs: we provide structured audit exports (S3 export or secure link) and can prepare a short demo of the logging schema.
- UK Addendum: we generally accept counterparty addenda with a short redline pass. We'll prepare a Redwood-drafted addendum if you'd prefer.
- VPC/pilot: Kimberly will confirm operational constraints and a pilot checklist.

Laura/Kim — can we organize a 30-minute sync tomorrow to split tasks? Samantha — would 10:00–11:00 PT on Tue work for a quick alignment?
